refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
intsleep intseconds
Delays the program execution for the given number of seconds.
In order to delay program execution for a fraction of a second, use usleep as the sleep function expects an &integer;. A fractional seconds is truncated, so sleep(0.25) pauses program execution for 0 seconds; as of PHP 8.1.0 this emits an E_DEPRECATED ("Implicit conversion from float 0.25 to int loses precision"), and under declare(strict_types=1) it throws a TypeError.
